From f223ebffa185cc8da934333c5a31ff2d4f992dc9 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Bartlomiej Kubik <kubik.bartlomiej@gmail.com>
Date: Wed, 26 Nov 2025 23:02:51 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] fs/ntfs3: Initialize new folios before use

KMSAN reports an uninitialized value in longest_match_std(), invoked
from ntfs_compress_write(). When new folios are allocated without being
marked uptodate and ni_read_frame() is skipped because the caller expects
the frame to be completely overwritten, some reserved folios may remain
only partially filled, leaving the rest memory uninitialized.

Fixes: 584f60ba22f7 ("ntfs3: Convert ntfs_get_frame_pages() to use a folio")
Tested-by: syzbot+08d8956768c96a2c52cf@syzkaller.appspotmail.com
Reported-by: syzbot+08d8956768c96a2c52cf@syzkaller.appspotmail.com
Closes: https://syzkaller.appspot.com/bug?extid=08d8956768c96a2c52cf

Signed-off-by: Bartlomiej Kubik <kubik.bartlomiej@gmail.com>
Signed-off-by: Konstantin Komarov <almaz.alexandrovich@paragon-software.com>

diff --git a/fs/ntfs3/file.c b/fs/ntfs3/file.c
index 2e7b2e566ebe..732260087066 100644
--- a/fs/ntfs3/file.c
+++ b/fs/ntfs3/file.c
@@ -995,7 +995,7 @@ static int ntfs_get_frame_pages(struct address_space *mapping, pgoff_t index,
 
 		folio = __filemap_get_folio(mapping, index,
 					    FGP_LOCK | FGP_ACCESSED | FGP_CREAT,
-					    gfp_mask);
+					    gfp_mask | __GFP_ZERO);
 		if (IS_ERR(folio)) {
 			while (npages--) {
 				folio = page_folio(pages[npages]);
-- 
2.34.1

The patch fixes an uninitialized memory issue in the NTFS3 file system driver by modifying a single file: `fs/ntfs3/file.c`. The change occurs in the function `ntfs_get_frame_pages`, where the `__GFP_ZERO` flag is added to the `gfp_mask` when creating new folios via `__filemap_get_folio`. This ensures that newly allocated folios are zero-initialized, preventing the use of uninitialized memory in the subsequent compression write path (`ntfs_compress_write` → `longest_match_std`), where partially filled folios could otherwise leak uninitialized data.

2. output the file name that is most likely to cause the bug.

You are a programming expert.

The code statements that lead to the bug are:
folio = __filemap_get_folio(mapping, index,
                            FGP_LOCK | FGP_ACCESSED | FGP_CREAT,
                            gfp_mask);
Reason:
New folios allocated without `__GFP_ZERO` leave the memory uninitialized. When `ni_read_frame()` is skipped because the frame is expected to be completely overwritten, the reserved folios remain partially filled with uninitialized data. This uninitialized memory is later accessed in `longest_match_std()` during compression, triggering a KMSAN warning.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
folio = __filemap_get_folio(mapping, index,
                            FGP_LOCK | FGP_ACCESSED | FGP_CREAT,
                            gfp_mask | __GFP_ZERO);
Reason:
Adding `__GFP_ZERO` ensures all newly allocated folios are zero-initialized. Even when the read from disk is skipped, the folio's unused memory is zero, preventing the use of uninitialized data and eliminating the KMSAN detection.
